module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 19

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

@[expose] public section



namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture19

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 19](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

If `G` is connected then the size `b(G)` of a largest induced bipartite subgraph
satisfies
`b(G) ≥ FLOOR((∑ ecc(v))/(|V|) + sSup (range (l G)))`, where `ecc(v)` denotes
eccentricity and `l(G)` is the independence number of neighbourhoods.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture19 (G : SimpleGraph α) [Nontrivial α] (h_conn : G.Connected) :
    ⌊(∑ v ∈ Finset.univ, ((G.eccent v).toNat : ℝ)) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) +
      sSup (Set.range (indepNeighbors G))⌋ ≤ b G := by
  sorry

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture19

reformulations.difference: Lean explicitly assumes `[Nontrivial α]`; the source states the conjecture for simple connected graphs without that restriction.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: The only connected finite graphs omitted are one-vertex graphs. Their eccentricity and local independence number are both zero, and their largest induced bipartite subgraph has one vertex, so the required inequality is 0 ≤ 1. Consequently, including or excluding this case gives equivalent universal conjectures. The equivalence with and without the Nontrivial hypothesis was proved in /workspace/review/scratch.lean without using conjecture19.

sources_consulted: https://web.archive.org/web/20260726061534/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html — Conjecture 19, its status and accompanying remark; also the referenced Conjecture 13.
https://web.archive.org/web/20241118002601id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/list.htm — introduction and conventions for induced-subgraph orders.
review.notes: The statement agrees with source Conjecture 19: b(G) ≥ FLOOR(average eccentricity + maximum local independence). The July 2026 archived source marks it O (open), consistent with the file. Archived pages were used because the live site's HTTPS endpoint was unavailable. Checked all imported invariants, the real-valued average and floor, and supremum boundedness. Lean proofs confirm that connectedness and finiteness prevent infinite eccentricities from reaching ENat.toNat's default value, that the denominator is positive, and that the real supremum equals the finite maximum. Boundary proofs and computations for complete graphs, paths, a star and cycles passed in /workspace/review/scratch.lean and /workspace/review/computations.lean.
